repair_arguments: Every CAS retry decodes the newly observed atomic word before combining evidence. A delayed Unknown cannot replace a valid sign; delayed inexact/missing magnitude cannot replace an exact magnitude.

Known signs and nonzero status combine with independent magnitude evidence while preserving unrelated metadata bits. Existing inexact hints are retained until an exact certificate arrives; no ordering of those hints is claimed.

For a separated integer sample a, the closed interval [abs(a)-1, abs(a)+1] lies in a single binade exactly when a is neither a power of two nor one below the next power. A representable exponent is also required. The 525 retained endpoint checks use independent exact rational magnitudes.
Bound sign certificates are available to both root and descendant sign queries. A reciprocal algebraic separation proof needs denominator nonzero status, which need not include orientation.
The scheduling hooks and destructive resets are compiled only in tests. Production publication does not gain test synchronization fields.

next_regressions_from_source_review.area: Public meaning of inexact magnitude information
next_regressions_from_source_review.source_observation: MagnitudeBits describes exact_msd=false as a conservative structural bound, while certified_sign_and_msd explicitly warns that these estimates can drift after sums, cancellation and inversion. The current merge therefore cannot rank two inexact hints mathematically. The existing Verus bound_denotes and exported_magnitude_is_a_certificate likewise constrain exponents only when exact_msd is true; their names do not establish the stronger public inexact-bound wording.
proposed_witnesses: A raw Add chain starting at 2 with 96 additions of 1 can retain an inexact exponent 1 even though the exact value 98 has exponent 6; the differing-exponent sum rule takes max without accounting for carry.
Raw subtraction 2 - (2 - 2^-N), with exact rational leaves, can retain an inexact exponent 1 while the exact result has exponent -N; opposite-sign cancellation can make the hint arbitrarily high.
General non-power-of-two rational scaling currently adds MSDs and marks the result inexact, which can be one binade below the exact product.
next_regressions_from_source_review.next_action: Execute independent exact-rational regressions through public facts and warm/cold orders. Define a consistent certificate contract and audit every producer, consumer, overflow case and monotone merge before changing it. Do not merely rename unsupported estimates as certificates or discard valid proof reuse. Update mathematical denotation/proof obligations along with any contract repair; existing conditional exact-MSD theorems are insufficient for a new upper-bound claim.
next_regressions_from_source_review.candidate_design_to_evaluate: An explicitly documented upper-bound exponent would make inexact facts ordered by smaller bounds. Addition/product/square must account for carries, inverse needs a lower magnitude certificate (available from an exact MSD), numerical all-ones endpoints need the next exponent, and non-dyadic Real scaling must account for carry. This design is not implemented or validated here.
